population: Every outbound and template record in the selected full export
method: Priority-ordered pattern rules, every message assigned once; no sampled counts extrapolated.
limitation: Content patterns are not contextual proof of a complete, correct or useful answer; unclear messages are not counted as direct answers.

rows.category: Answer-like information or instructions PLUS a link detected
Contains explicit inability or missing-information wording
Link/navigation; link or location requested in the nearest user message
Link or referral without detected answer content; request match not established
Asks for clarification or more context
Greeting, acknowledgement, offer or conversational follow-up
Other text/media; direct versus partial answer cannot be determined by these rules
Automatic/template messages, counted separately from regular text
